title: The Dow Market Happenings For Thursday, October 4, 2018
text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Thursday, October 4, 2018 Posted by admin on October 4th, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Apple (AAPL), Boeing (BA), Cisco (CSCO), Disney (DIS), Merck (MRK), Microsoft (MSFT), Pfizer (PFE) and UnitedHealth (UNH). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -93 points.
Wednesday the Dow was up +54.45 (+0.20%) at 26,828.39.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +8.53%.
There were 14 Dow stocks up Wednesday.
The Dow stock winners Wednesday were led by Boeing (BA) +1.53% and Intel (INTC) +1.37%.
The Dow stock losers Wednesday were led by Procter & Gamble (PG) -1.58% and Coca Cola (KO) -1.38%.
International Business Machines (IBM -0.34%) was rated a new ‘Sell’ at MoffetNathanson with a price target of $150.
McDonald’s (MCD -0.31%) was rated a new ‘Overweight’ at KeyBanc Capital Markets with a price target of $185.
European stocks are mostly lower and Asian markets ended mostly lower.
The national average price of gasoline is up nine-tenths of a cent at $2.911 per gallon.
Earnings Reports .
Nike (NKE) reported earnings on 9/25/2018 after the market close of $0.67, just beating estimates calling for $0.657 per share.
Walgreens (WBA) reports earnings on 10/11/18 before the market open.
JPMorgan (JPM) reports earnings on 10/12/18 before the market open.
Goldman Sachs (GS) reports earnings on 10/16/18 before the market open.
IBM (IBM) reports earnings on 10/16/18 after the market close.
Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) reports earnings on 10/16/18 before the market open.
UnitedHealth (UNH) reports earnings on 10/16/18 before the market open.
